provenance.machine: Apple M2 Max (8 performance + 4 efficiency cores)
provenance.command: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=$N ULTRAVIN_NOW_MICROS=1788220800000000 target/release/examples/throughput target/bench/independent-sink-corpus.txt 10 batch full auto
provenance.method: Median of two fresh-process trials per worker count, run 1/4/12 then 12/4/1. Each process warms one full unique pass, then times one full unique pass including calibration, live tuning, full native results, order restoration and synchronous cleanup. Each trial started once the one-minute load average was at most 2.5 (2.2-2.5 at start).
provenance.other_engines: corgi and NHTSA rows are their earlier published or measured figures; they were not re-run for this session.

sorted_rows.corpus: the same twenty million VINs, byte-sorted (LC_ALL=C sort)
sorted_rows.method: Same command and two-trial median as the shuffled rows, run later on September 23 paired with fresh shuffled trials on a busier host (one-minute load 2.1-3.0); raw runs in scripts/bench/sorted_corpus_2026_09_23.json.
